summary: This is an amendment to an 8-K correcting the item designation from Item 2.02 to Item 8.01. The filing announces that the board of directors will hold a special meeting on July 28, 2026 to consider resumption of quarterly dividends. No dividend terms, amounts, or dates are specified. A dividend resumption consideration is not a special situation event; it is routine corporate governance. Therefore, this filing does not constitute an activist campaign, capital return (since no declaration or fixed amount), or any other special situation category.
